OSNet architecture from Kaiyang Zhou's MIT-licensed deep-person-reid:
https://github.com/KaiyangZhou/deep-person-reid/blob/master/torchreid/models/osnet.py
Downloaded 2026-11-01. Unmodified architecture; no weights in Git.
The M9 loader uses pretrained=False and explicitly validates the separately
supplied author-published MSMT17-combineall checkpoint. No startup downloads.
